# Cascadia Recovery Foundation

> > Cascadia Recovery Foundation provides comprehensive addiction recovery programs, sober living homes, mental health counseling, and life skills training in Beaverton, Oregon.

The foundation offers integrated recovery support combining housing, counseling, community outreach, and educational workshops to help individuals overcome substance abuse and rebuild their lives. Services include volunteer opportunities, family support systems, and evidence-based treatment approaches.

## Key Topics

- addiction recovery
- sober living homes
- mental health counseling
- recovery programs
- substance abuse treatment
